passed_checks.check_name: Ensure that CloudWatch alarm actions are enabled
code_block:
resource "aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm" "ec2_high_cpu" {
  alarm_name          = "ec2-${var.instance_id}-high-cpu-utilization"
  alarm_description   = "Alarm when EC2 instance ${var.instance_id} CPU utilization exceeds 80% for 10 consecutive minutes."
  namespace           = "AWS/EC2"
  metric_name         = "CPUUtilization"
  statistic           = "Average"
  period              = 60
  evaluation_periods  = 10
  datapoints_to_alarm = 10
  threshold           = 80
  comparison_operator = "GreaterThanThreshold"
  treat_missing_data  = "missing"

  dimensions = {
    InstanceId = var.instance_id
  }

  actions_enabled           = true
  alarm_actions             = local.alarm_actions
  ok_actions                = local.alarm_actions
  insufficient_data_actions = []

  tags = {
    ManagedBy  = "Terraform"
    InstanceId = var.instance_id
    Severity   = "high"
  }
}
